8B.01.b:
### Point & say — the portals
[[FIG: Fig 8B.3, 8B.4, 8B.5, 8B.6, 8B.7 · 8B.01
| Portal | Where | At risk |
|---|---|---|
| **Anteromedial** (first) | Joint line, just **medial to TA** (tibialis anterior) | Saphenous nerve + vein → fewest structures |
| **Anterolateral** | Joint line, just **lateral to peroneus tertius** | **SPN** (intermediate dorsal cutaneous) |
| **Posterolateral** | Lateral edge of the Achilles, ≈1 cm above the fibular tip | **Sural nerve** + small saphenous vein |
| Posteromedial (hindfoot endoscopy only) | Medial to the Achilles | **Tibial bundle** → stay lateral to FHL (flexor hallucis longus) |

- **Mark the SPN first** in plantar flexion + inversion → transillumination misses it
- Hindfoot endoscopy → **prone** · **FHL = the medial border of safety** · commonest complication → **nerve injury**

- **Anterolateral** → lateral to peroneus tertius → **SPN**, marked in plantar flexion + inversion
- **Posterolateral** → beside the Achilles, 1 cm above the fibular tip → sural nerve
- Avoid anterocentral (DP artery, DPN) · nick the skin, spread, suture the portals
